QuestInfo.name: 2011 Pink Flower Tube!
QuestInfo.0: Go see #b#p9010010##k if you want to receive a Pink Flower Tube.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra says she will give you a beautiful Pink Flower Tube if you have a #b#t4001320##k.
QuestInfo.2: Enjoy the summer of 2011 with a Pink Flower Tube!

0.0: Ahh, it's so cold! So what do I do? I, Cassandra, have prepared a special present for you! Do you want a Pink Flower Floatie?

yes.0: All right then, hunt the monsters to obtain the #b#t02430016##k, and bring the #b#t04001320##k, which will open the box. \nThe #bSummer Lucky Cute Item!#k can be used when playing in the water, or when you hunt. I will trade it for a flower-patterned tube.

no.0: The Flower Floatie is only available during the Summer!

1.0: Wow, you managed to find the exchange coupon! As promised, here's the floatie.

yes.0: During the Summer, if you give me an exchange coupon, I'll accept it in exchange for a floatie.

item.0: You don't get anything if you don't have a #b#t04001320##k.
